en.title: Start and continue
items: Three agent tools
Use Claude Code, Codex and DeepSeek Harness in one workspace.
Model and reasoning controls
Choose an available model, reasoning effort and permission mode.
File and image context
Attach source material and reference images to a brief.
Follow-ups while work runs
Add another instruction without waiting for the task to finish.
Task tabs
Move between tasks while keeping each conversation in place.
Cross-session search
Find previous work by title, plan or conversation text.

en.title: More than one agent
items: A tool per task
Pick Claude Code, Codex or DeepSeek Harness when you brief a task, then a model from that tool.
Handoff across tools
Name another tool's model in a handoff and the next session runs there.
The plan travels
A handoff can carry the plan and the step it stopped on.
Notes along the chain
A successor session can read the notes its predecessors left behind.
Shared wiki and deliverables
A report one tool publishes is what the next tool reads back.
Mixed sessions stay legible
When several tools are running, the session list marks which one each task is on.

en.title: See the work as it happens
items: List and gallery views
See multiple sessions and their current states together.
Live activity
Distinguish thinking, tool execution, output and waiting for input.
Full conversation timeline
Inspect thinking, tool calls and code changes.
Subagents and workflows
Follow parent sessions, subagent work and workflow relationships.
Interrupt and stop
Take control of a stuck or no-longer-needed session.
Session organization
Rename, mark and filter sessions to keep useful work easy to find.

en.title: Keep a person in the loop
items: One decision queue
Handle questions, permissions and plan approvals together.
Materials beside the decision
Review documents, images and HTML previews alongside a decision.
Options and structured forms
Use single choice, multiple choice, free text and form fields.
Pre-execution guard
Review risk analysis before supported commands run.
Editable plan approval
Read and edit a proposed plan before approving it.
Decision history
Keep questions, choices and feedback for later review.

en.title: Keep longer work moving
items: Durable plans and task trees
Track phases and keep the plan with the work.
Context handoffs
Start a successor session with a handoff brief.
Visible handoff chains
Trace the sessions that carried a piece of work forward.
One-time schedules
Start a task at a specified time.
Recurring tasks
Repeat checks or routine work on a schedule.
Condition-based runs
Wait for an event and run the agent only when the condition is met.

en.title: Keep the output and the knowledge
items: Multi-format previews
Preview PDFs, Office files, images, video and web documents.
Export deliverables
Download finished files or hand them to someone else.
Favorites, notes and project filters
Organize deliverables without relying on filenames alone.
Project wiki publishing
Keep reusable HTML reports and Markdown documents.
Wiki search and cross-links
Search full text and reference conclusions across documents and sessions.
Document version history
Update a document while keeping earlier versions available.

en.title: Connect projects and devices
items: File explorer
Browse project files, images and source code.
Git status, pull and push
See the branch, ahead/behind counts and changed files, then pull or push from the interface.
Terminal and processes
Run commands and inspect terminal output and process state.
SSH workspaces
Connect projects and agent environments on another machine.
Browser access and self-hosting
Run Fleet Web UI on your own always-on machine.
QR pairing and multiple devices
Pair a phone with desktop Fleet and switch between devices.

en.title: Understand usage and execution
items: Account quota windows
See supported account quotas and reset windows.
Tokens and estimated cost
Review per-session consumption and estimated totals.
Live speed and spend trends
Watch output speed and changes in spend.
Daily work reports
Summarize sessions, output and work that needs attention.
Command auditing
Review executed commands by risk category.
Environment setup and diagnostics
Check installation, versions, sign-in and tool availability.

en.title: Make it work your way
items: Skill browsing and sync
Inspect skills and synchronize them across supported tools.
Plugins and marketplaces
Browse, install and manage plugin sources.
Memory rules and history
Inspect project memory, revision history and rule scope.
Start and review from a phone
Start tasks, add instructions and answer decisions from a phone.
Voice transcription and image input
Turn speech into editable text and add images to a brief.
Notifications, sounds and speech
Choose how Fleet gets your attention.

zh.title: 开始与继续工作
items: 三种 Agent 入口
在同一工作台使用 Claude Code、Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness。
模型与推理强度
按任务选择可用模型、推理强度和权限模式。
文件与图片上下文
把资料和参考图片附在任务里。
运行中追加要求
不必等任务结束，再补充一条要求。
多标签工作区
在多个任务间切换，保留各自的上下文。
跨会话搜索
按标题、计划与会话全文找回以前的工作。

zh.title: 多个 AI 工具协同
items: 每个任务各选工具
交代任务时选定 Claude Code、Codex 或 DeepSeek Harness，再挑它自己的模型。
跨工具接力
交接时指定另一个工具的模型，下一棒就在那个工具里继续。
计划跟着交接走
交接可以带上计划，以及停在哪一步。
笔记沿接力链可读
后一棒读得到前几棒留下的笔记。
共用知识库与产出
一个工具发布的报告和产出，另一个工具读得回来。
混跑时看得清
几个工具同时在跑时，会话列表标出每个任务用的是哪一个。

zh.title: 看清 Agent 在做什么
items: 列表与画廊视图
同时查看多个会话及其当前状态。
实时执行状态
区分思考、执行、输出与等待输入。
完整会话时间线
展开思考、工具调用和代码差异。
子 Agent 与工作流
查看父子会话、分工与工作流关系。
中断与停止
直接接管卡住或不再需要的会话。
标记与会话整理
重命名、标记和筛选，留下值得回看的工作。

zh.title: 人来做决定
items: 统一决策队列
问题、权限与计划审批集中处理。
材料与决定并排
直接审阅文档、图片与 HTML 预览。
选项与结构化表单
支持单选、多选、自由回答和表单字段。
执行前风险拦截
在受支持的命令执行前查看风险分析。
可编辑的计划审批
先看计划，必要时修改，再批准执行。
完整决策记录
保留问题、选择和反馈，回看来龙去脉。

zh.title: 让长任务接着做
items: 持久计划与任务树
按阶段追踪进度，计划随任务保留。
上下文交接
带着交接简报启动后继会话。
可追溯的接力链
回看一项工作经过了哪些会话。
一次性定时任务
让任务在指定时间启动。
周期性任务
按计划重复执行检查或整理工作。
条件触发与便宜探测
等待外部事件，满足条件后再唤起 Agent。

zh.title: 留下成果与知识
items: 多格式文件预览
查看 PDF、Office、图片、视频及网页文档。
导出与取走文件
把完成的文件下载或交给其他人。
收藏、备注与项目筛选
按用途整理交付物，不用靠文件名猜。
发布到项目知识库
保存可复用的 HTML 报告和 Markdown 文档。
知识库搜索与互链
全文搜索，并在文档和会话里引用结论。
文档版本历史
更新同一篇文档，保留旧版本可回看。

zh.title: 连接项目与设备
items: 文件树与内容预览
浏览项目文件、图片与代码内容。
Git 状态与拉取推送
查看分支、领先落后数与改动文件，并在界面中执行拉取与推送。
内置终端与进程
运行命令，查看终端输出和进程状态。
SSH 远端工作区
连接其他机器上的项目与 Agent 环境。
浏览器与自托管
在自己的常在线机器上运行 Fleet Web UI。
扫码配对与多设备
手机连接桌面，在多台设备之间切换。

zh.title: 观察用量与运行质量
items: 账号额度窗口
查看受支持账号的额度与重置时间。
Token 与费用估算
查看会话消耗与汇总费用。
实时速度与花费趋势
留意输出速度及费用增长。
每日工作报告
汇总会话、产出和需要关注的工作。
命令审计
按风险类别回看执行过的命令。
环境安装与诊断
检查安装、版本、登录与工具可用性。

zh.title: 按自己的习惯使用
items: 技能浏览与同步
查看技能内容，并同步到支持的工具。
插件与市场管理
浏览、安装和管理插件来源。
记忆规则与历史
查看项目记忆、历史版本与规则归属。
手机发起与接手
在手机上发任务、补充要求和回答决定。
语音转写与图片输入
把语音转成可编辑文字，配合图片交代任务。
通知、提示音与播报
按自己的节奏选择提醒方式。
